hidden_test_cmd: sh -c 'PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" exec python -m pytest -q -p no:subtests "$@"' sh tests/hidden
tests_may_change_note: A feature naturally adds cases to the existing Snowflake test that already round-trips VECTOR_COSINE_SIMILARITY, to the BigQuery/ClickHouse function tests, and to list-style function tests. TestDuckDB::test_nearest_join (which round-trips ARRAY_COSINE_SIMILARITY) is deliberately not listed: the ticket keeps the ARRAY_ variants unchanged. Fixture files (tests/fixtures/...) are not test code.

feature.note: a real defect on main (Snowflake VECTOR_COSINE_SIMILARITY read as exp.CosineDistance), still present upstream on 2026-11-23, so no upstream fix exists to be remembered

naive_patches.naive.patch: the right mapping, but 1 - distance built without parentheses: wrong inside a larger expression (1 - COSINE_DISTANCE(a, b) * 2)
naive_patches.naive-distance.patch: similarity added, but Snowflake still writes a cosine distance as VECTOR_COSINE_SIMILARITY
